question: Does a discounted, shrunken same-day departure-phase state add remaining-wait information beyond lap/elapsed/15-minute clock and beyond a matched two-history phase?
chronology: Reuse cycle1 535 completed visits: train Sep3/4/8/9, calibration Sep10/11 unused for fitting, inspected development Sep14–17 through13:14 ET. No fresh holdout.
core: Reuse exact cycle1 frozen core coefficients and source design; do not refit or change own-lap support.
state: Per stable bus_name, stop, ET date. Use only modern confirmed departures available at focal pin. Retain phase as complex weighted sum with two-hour elapsed-departure half-life; confidence=abs(sum)/(sumWeights+2). Minimum two confirmed same-stop histories; zero features if unsupported.
twoHistoryAblation: Same history eligibility, reset and shrinkage; only the two most recent departures, equal weight. This is a matched hazard ablation, not the earlier calibrated slot-center residual model.
phase: Hourly period fixed from prior recurrence evidence, no vehicle ID coefficient and no retrospective bus/day phase. Three columns: confidence*sin(future deterministic hourly clock - prior phase), confidence*cos(...), confidence.
resets: ET date; latest known all-route non-Red anchor; gap outside30–90min between recorded same-stop departures; absent intervening confirmed opposite departure; circular phase innovation beyond training-only pooled per-stop95th percentile of absolute adjacent hourly phase changes (no development selection). At pin require last history within90min, intervening confirmed opposite and supported existing lap.
availability: Primary max(departed+120s, first_moved+confirm_sec). Sensitivity adds another120s to all departure availability. Anchors known at anchored+15s only for route reassignment. These proxies are not original publication receipts. Snapshot frozen at pin through every forecast landmark and future hazard row.
support: At least5 training visits and2 dates; no per-stop or feature choice from development. Core offset fixed; fit three added columns jointly.
weighting: Reuse cycle1 inverse eligible-landmark count per visit. Primary overall each visit equal total weight. Also equal-checkpoint scores; at fixed landmarks explicitly original-cohort weighted vs equal-checkpoint.
survival: Reuse15sec hazard risk-bin likelihood and1800sec right-censored exposure with continued final hazard tail; no outcome trimming, no quantile cap.
comparators: Exact frozen current-code component and matched core on identical722 development checkpoints. PR282 changes no comparator ETA/calibration code; all previous comparator input hashes verified before reuse. Not live pooled full ETA.
promotion: No release from component screen. Any positive candidate requires independent audit then complete warm release-ON rider replay with connected first/second targets, both tails, stability, availability and transitions.
